title: 1:1 prep - Jamie Chen & Samir Azad
body:
Context:
- Weekly 1:1 with Samir (IC3 -> senior IC track conversation ongoing). Goal: unblock current sprint work, check career progression, sync on timeline for KV cache improvements and small infra spike.

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick personal check-in (5m)
  - How are you feeling about workload, burnout risk, energy levels? Any time off coming?
2) Sprint status & blockers (10m)
  - PRs in review: feature/kvcache-lru (WIP), perf/seqlen-optim (waiting infra), fix/kv-restore (QA flaky)
  - Metrics to call out: avg PR review time 42h (goal < 36h), mean inference latency for nightly load test 120ms (baseline 110ms)
3) Career & growth (7m)
  - Review progress on leadership project: ownership of kvcache rollout plan, mentorship of junior Eng (Priya), doc for postmortems
  - Discuss promotion readiness checklist and gaps
4) Action items & priorities for next week (8m)
  - Align on top 3 priorities (deliverable + owner + ETA)
  - Any cross-team asks to escalate?

Notes / Talking points:
- Samir flagged that the KV cache LRU prototype regresses tail latency on longer contexts. Hypothesis: LRU eviction interacts poorly with current batched attention kernel -> need a small repro and microbenchmark.
- He is blocked waiting on infra to expose perf counters from the new kernel (requested infra ticket JIRA-4821, blocked until infra review).
- PR review bottleneck: only two reviewers available (Aisha + Carlos) and both on call rotation. Suggest rotating extra reviewer or pairing to reduce review time.
- Career: Samir shipped two medium-impact features last quarter; strong technical depth but needs more cross-team visibility and latests of end-to-end ownership (inc. post-launch metrics). He volunteered to run the kvcache rollout plan doc and lead the canary for one region.

Concise status snapshot (for quick paste into calendar/Slack):
- Current sprint: on track with 2/3 major items (kvcache LRU prototyping behind); blocker: infra perf counters (JIRA-4821). PR review backlog causing ~1.5 day delay.

Immediate asks I should make (manager action):
- Ping infra leads to prioritize perf counters review (cc: Mikayla).
- Temporarily assign an additional reviewer for Samir's kvcache PR (ask Aisha if she can 1h pair review tomorrow).
- Approve 1d buffer for Samir to build microbench repro and draft perf notes.

Career/progression checklist notes (to discuss):
- Strengths: deep systems knowledge, good debugging, independently shipped runtime changes.
- Gaps: product context + cross-team comms, measurable post-launch metrics ownership, mentoring footprint.
- Proposed next steps: 1) Lead kvcache rollout doc + run canary (Q2) 2) Shadow product sync for two sprints 3) Start 1:1 mentorship with Priya and document sessions.

Action items (from this 1:1):
- Samir: create microbenchmark repro for LRU tail latency + link results to PR by 2026-03-10 (owner: Samir)
- Jamie (me): escalate JIRA-4821 to Mikayla (infra) and request a 3-day turnaround; notify Samir once queued — due 2026-03-05 (owner: Jamie Chen)
- Jamie: add an interim reviewer rotation to reduce review time; ask Aisha to pair-review tomorrow (2026-03-04) (owner: Jamie Chen)
- Samir: draft kvcache rollout doc outline and proposed canary plan; share for feedback by 2026-03-17 (owner: Samir)
- Samir + Priya: schedule weekly 30m mentorship sync starting next week (owner: Samir)

Follow-ups for next 1:1:
- Check status of microbenchmark (was regression reproduced?).
- Review initial rollout doc outline; pick canary region and success metrics.
- Review PR review time improvement after reviewer rotation.
- Quick career check-in: evidence of cross-team engagement (did he join product sync?).

Open questions / things to decide offline:
- If LRU repro shows persistent tail regressions, consider reverting LRU change and try alternate eviction (freq-based) — need input from research/algorithms.
- If infra can't prioritize perf counters, propose temporary perf data export via nightly test harness (low-effort workaround).

Misc scratch notes (short):
- Possible PR to add perf counters to kernel: minor API change, may be low-risk.
- Slack threads: #infra-kernel (link in linked_artifacts).

Draft quick message to Samir (post-1:1):
"Thanks for the sync — I’ll escalate JIRA-4821 to Mikayla and try to get Aisha to pair-review your PR tomorrow. Please push the repro and perf notes; if you hit any blockers ping me in Slack and I’ll jump on a short pairing session. Re: promotion, leading the rollout doc will be a strong signal — aim to have outline by Mar 17 so we can iterate."

—— end of notes
